programmes.d: Cisco and Pancho stumble across a ranch where the owner is arguing with a number of farm hands. It appears some of the cows have died from disease and the rest will need to be quarantined.
Cisco and Pancho break a woman out of jail after she has been sentenced to hang for a murder she did not commit.
Jasper King has asked his old friend Cisco to help him stop the marriage between his niece Nancy and the gangster Duke Ralston.
A handsome gambler moves into town and begins wooing Milly Scott, claiming to have known her deceased brother.
Lucas develops temporary amnesia from a head injury while visiting a strange town and mistakenly assumes the identity of a wanted criminal.
Josh rides into a town looking for a man who asked him to come there for a job that pays $500.
Josh is hired by Harry Weaver to track down his twin brother Pete, who's wanted with a $500 bounty on him.
An old school friend of Annie's breaks out of jail with two other inmates to go search for the treasure at the mission.
With an outlaw at large and the Sheriff searching for him, trouble arrives in the form of a fake sheriff, a drunk, and a senseless murder.

While awaiting word from the mine to see if they found gold, Annie discovers a beloved stagecoach is now being driven by a woman, the daughter of the owner who is now threatening to sell the stage and pocket the money.
Jim Bowie, Sam Houston (later to be the first governor of Texas) and Jean LaFitte, the pirate, are clashing characters, all in competition in bidding for a racing mare for President Jackson.
When an alms-seeker, who has brought good luck to Jim Bowie, is brutally attacked for no apparent reason, Bowie finds him a haven with the 10-year-old Marquis and his aunt.
Jim Bowie and Osceola, Seminole renegade chief, match knife against lance, with complications for Bowie in trying to get Osceola to compromise with the United States.
Bowie buys a lottery ticket from Jean Dubois, a former champion swordsman, who is trying to raise money for his daughter's dowry.
Cisco and Pancho stumble across a ranch where the owner is arguing with a number of farm hands. It appears some of the cows have died from disease and the rest will need to be quarantined.
Cisco and Pancho break a woman out of jail after she has been sentenced to hang for a murder she did not commit.
Jasper King has asked his old friend Cisco to help him stop the marriage between his niece Nancy and the gangster Duke Ralston.
A dying man offers Josh $2000 to find his son, who ran away from home 15 years ago.
Josh and Jason are escorting four prisoners - three men and one woman - to Leavenworth prison when a stranger begins following along behind asking to travel with the group for protection.
Josh is summoned for help when the Pinto bank is robbed.
Josh expects a $400 bounty for bringing in Daniel Trenner but finds his prisoner stolen from him by the sheriff.
Josh is hired by a woman to sober up Harry a drunk who is also Josh's friend.
Josh and the beautiful female prisoner he is transporting to trial are on a three-day trip while her partner is still on the loose in the area.
Josh is on his way to River City to transport three convicts there to be hanged.
A journalist from Boston accompanies Josh on his manhunt to get an exclusive story on a bounty hunter as part of a series of articles.
Josh feels compelled to repay a debt to an old friend who's in jail and may hang.
Josh brings in outlaw Carlos Domingo but he has to be released when the witness against him is killed in front of Josh.
Josh is sent for by Sheriff Mike Strata and the desperate men of Coronado.
Josh brings in a young man wanted for robbery but loses his reward and expenses.
Josh arrives in a town for rest and to gamble just as the local bank has been robbed.
A widow wants to hire/propose to Josh so she doesn't lose custody of her son.
A woman asks Josh, an old friend, to help find her husband Frank - a bounty hunter out to settle a score.
When Randall has a sheriff bed a prisoner, the man's gang kidnaps the sheriff and two others and threatens to kill one per day until the man is freed.
A dance hall woman is disliked by the ladies of the town until she takes care of the ill during an epidemic.
After living in Washington, the newly appointed director of the Carson City mint is in for a rude awakening.
The town drunk Solomon asks the current newspaper owner to aid in his tall tales to his sister.
The dispute over the California-Nevada state border causes problems for a man and the woman he loves.
Bill Stewart tries his hand in California as a gold miner but quickly realizes his future lies as a lawyer.
The new schoolteacher tames her unruly classroom by demonstrating her skills with a six shooter.
Cavalry man Larry Brooks is escorting a group through peaceful Native territory when threats arise.
A woman in love with a fire chief has a rival: a flashy fire engine.
A little girl grows up to become a performer in a vaudeville show.
A young miner is afflicted with a monumental problem: claustrophobia.
The discovery of a nugget weighing 12 pounds causes an uproar in a California gold town.
Jimmy Dayton buys a toupee and a set of store teeth, hoping to win the hand of a gold-digging dance girl.
John Thompson wants to get the mail out during the winters and comes up with creative ways to make it happen.
A mining engineer is sent to negotiate a peace treaty with Natives, and a young lady complicates his mission.
